abstracts.abstract: Requires notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases to include a statement on the first page explaining in plain language the tenant's right to answer or reply and how a tenant may request an extension of time to submit such answer or reply.

bill.title: Relates to notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases

posted_text:
🔑 NY A11710 — Tenants Get 60 Days to Respond to Rent Hikes

New York tenants filing a claim for a major rent increase due to capital improvements now have 60 days from the mailing of a proceeding notice to respond.

The notice must include a plain-language explanation of the tenant’s rights and how to request an extension, along with a list of legal services providers.

Sept. 16, 2026: Referred to Housing.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/bills/2025/A11710
